description: Iterate a weighted transform set from supplied seeds and accumulate the point process into a bilinear density buffer.
output_invariants: Detached finite density buffer; plotted+dropped equals iterations; no partial result on failure.

behavior.validation: Exact passive Object/null-prototype records, dense ordinary arrays with own data slots, no classes/accessors/symbols/extras/coercion; proxies outside interchange. Numeric values finite binary64; booleans never numbers. Validate complete input in input-schema field order, arrays in order, then correspondence structure, then exact-integer work preflight before result allocation. Normalize accepted/exposed zero to +0. Inputs unchanged and all outputs deeply detached. Host allocation failure remains a host error.
behavior.environment: Accepted seeded 32-bit LCG, one draw per iterate; no clock, renderer or assets. Caller Cartesian coordinates; y-up or y-down is a presentation choice. p5-only initial delivery; no other-target equivalence, no learned preference or networked voting.
behavior.numerics: Binary64 separately rounded primitives, no FMA or reassociation. The transform and power evaluation may produce nonfinite values as a handled drop path: the inv power maps 0 to +Infinity by definition and a nonfinite iterate is counted in dropped with the running point reset to the next seed, not raised as NUMERIC_OVERFLOW. sin/cos use the accepted bit-exact fdlibm trig. The accumulated buffer is provably finite for valid inputs (each cell at most iterations), so NUMERIC_OVERFLOW is reserved and defensive. Compare counters, rngState, ordering and errors exactly; the density values are exact binary64.
behavior.correspondence: transforms is nonempty with a strictly positive finite total weight; each transform is a 2x2 a, a 2-vector t, an enum power and a nonnegative finite weight. seeds is nonempty, each a finite 2-vector. density is a positive width/height grid with a finite origin and a strictly positive 2-vector cell; width*height is a safe integer at most 2^32-1. rngState is a nonnegative safe integer at most 2^32-1.
behavior.work: W=iterations in exact integers, precharged before allocation; one counted event per iterate (RNG draw plus transform advance). The grid map and bilinear splat are constant-factor per iterate and do not grow work with grid size.
behavior.algorithm: Initialize the buffer to zero and plotted=dropped=0; cursor=0; running point=seeds[0]. For each iterate: draw the next LCG state, target=(state/2^32)*totalWeight, select the least transform index k with target<cumulative[k]; advance the running point q=A*power(p)+t. If q is nonfinite, count dropped, set cursor=(cursor+1) mod seeds.length and reset the running point to seeds[cursor]. Otherwise map q to grid space, i0=floor(gx), j0=floor(gy); if the containing cell is outside the grid count dropped and keep the running point at q. Otherwise deposit the per-iterate weight bilinearly over the up-to-four surrounding cells in the fixed order (i0,j0),(i0+1,j0),(i0,j0+1),(i0+1,j0+1), discarding out-of-range sub-cells (clamped, not redistributed), and count plotted. Return the detached buffer, counters and final rngState. No hidden normalization: the buffer holds raw accumulated weights.
behavior.native_surface: fractalFlameAccumulate2D(input), FractalFlameAccumulate2DError; fractal-flame-accumulate-2d.js and package index.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Static carrier/shape/domain/correspondence failure, including empty transforms/seeds, nonpositive weight total, unknown power, nonpositive cell, zero iterations or an oversized grid.
errors.WORK_LIMIT: Exact declared work reservation (iterations) exceeds maxWork.
errors.NUMERIC_OVERFLOW: Reserved; the transform may be nonfinite as a handled drop path and the buffer is provably finite for valid inputs, so this code is defensive, not expected.

transforms.unit: Weighted affine-plus-power map set; each entry advances the running point and carries a probability mass.
transforms.evidence: Independently specified design. No artist-source default or visually measured recommended range.

seeds.unit: Initial running points and the round-robin reset pool after a nonfinite iterate.
seeds.evidence: Independently specified design. No artist-source default or visually measured recommended range.

iterations.unit: Total iterates to scatter; also the exact work reservation.
iterations.evidence: Independently specified design. No artist-source default or visually measured recommended range.

density.unit: Axis-aligned cell grid (width, height, origin, cell) that receives the bilinear accumulation.
density.evidence: Independently specified design. No artist-source default or visually measured recommended range.

rngState.unit: Accepted 32-bit LCG seed; the final state is returned.
rngState.evidence: Independently specified design. No artist-source default or visually measured recommended range.

maxWork.unit: Iterate-event allowance; must be at least iterations.
